comments.body: f161 plan-review round 3 = BLOCK (G6). Fixed across 3 rounds, all findings verified against code first: (r1) E6/E2 unrunnable <placeholder> commands; G1G2 - the 3 OPERATOR-ATTESTED RULE statements are SHIPPED prompts (plan_review_F1/E2/E6.md) + coach_moves.py move 14, and docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md is GENERATED/parity-gated, so editing them would break AC-6's 'other clients unaffected' -> scoped all 4 sites OUT with a git diff --exit-code AC; T4 posture -> DET check ships ADVISORY via p6_ac_quality so pre-contract tickets are grandfathered with no migration; G6 -> narrowed the overclaim (environment is repo-refutable, principal/privilege_posture are NOT; inherits ADR-0043 trust boundary); T8 -> no-anchor produces NO finding. (r2) G6/T8 - every activated project.* criterion resolves its rubric from .rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-<name>.md (registry.build_descriptor -> criterion_prompt_id); omitting it = PromptNotFound -> added the file + exec AGENT. E6 - grep -c counts lines not occurrences -> replaced with a structural json.load assertion. (r3) G6 - textual form/location of the 3 fields was unspecified -> pinned as an indented 'provenance:' continuation line binding to the nearest preceding checkbox, with explicit placeholder semantics, and noted ac_item_lines cannot see continuation lines so the new module needs its own scanner. G6 advisory - the 3 neighbour project prompts are execution_mode: single_turn (tool-LESS); tooling is granted by the PROMPT's execution_mode per registry.py, so pinned execution_mode: agentic. comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body: PARALLEL PLAN-REVIEW WAVE 1 results: 271c PASS+signed, e59d-3418 PASS+signed (both 708d roots, now claimable). ea28 (8fc2 root) BLOCK on 2 findings that were one gap - rubric front-matter spec omitted title:, and build_descriptor computes name = prompt.title or cid, so the criterion name would degrade to the bare id T15 and AC#4 (rebar explain T15 prints the criterion name) would pass only degenerately; fixed by pinning title + the rationale, re-review running. f161 round 5 = BLOCK with 4 findings, ALL self-inflicted by the round-4 instrument-field edit: (1) E1/COH Approach-1 and AC-1 still said THREE fields while 1a said four; (2) G6 AC-5's instrument-vs-authorization judgement had NO mechanism assigned; (3) G6 I wrote 'at 1-TURN it would have no filesystem tooling', contradicting what I had already verified - tooling is granted by the PROMPT's execution_mode, not the routing exec tier - and mis-cited project.engine-layer-enforcement as an AGENT precedent when it is exec 1-TURN; (4) T8 rule (d) not co-located in the rubric spec. Remediated coherently: four fields everywhere, the two knobs separated (exec AGENT = agent loop, execution_mode agentic = tool grant, BOTH required), precedent re-scoped to the trigger mechanism only, and an explicit DET-vs-AGENT ownership split with rule (d) named as the escape-2b mechanism. Round 6 running.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body: Change 1423 (f161) round 1 of gate votes: LLM-Review +1 PASS (4 advisory), Verified -1. ROOT CAUSE = my own test, not a regression: test_shipped_contract_text_is_untouched ran 'git diff --exit-code origin/main -- <path>' and CI's checkout has no resolvable origin/main ref, so git exited 128 and the assertion reported 'was modified' when nothing was. Fixed by replacing the git dependency with a SHA256 digest of each site's contract-bearing lines (CONTRACT_DIGESTS), which tests the real invariant in any environment; verified it has teeth by tampering with one word of the E2 contract sentence (fails precisely). Also replaced a subprocess grep with a pure-Python walk - same environment-fragility class. Separately corrected an over-assertion: docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md is GENERATED and legitimately changes when any criterion is added, so byte-identity would have broken the moment ea28's T15 landed; only its contract SENTENCES are pinned now. Note my earlier prediction that CI would go red from the pre-existing grounding failure was WRONG for this run - the real cause was mine. Stack rebuilt (reset+amend+cherry-pick) preserving both Change-Ids; 1423/1424 updated in place. ea28 also implemented+validated: 16/16 incl 5 held-out, 3 mutations killed (routing tier downgrade, rubric execution_mode, dropped SCOPED CLEANUP check), first-attempt.
